latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing Maker Free — hassle-free, cloud-based video editing for everyone.

- Upload raw video clips (up to 500MB, various formats) and describe your desired edit; the service handles everything else.
- Export finished 1080p MP4 videos quickly, ideal for casual creators and students who want results without complex software.
- Simple authentication—automatically fetches a free token for new users, with 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports common video, image, and audio formats; all AI-driven editing is performed remotely on GPU servers.
- Check balance, session status, and export/download videos easily through structured commands or chat prompts.
